approval-rules.title: Approval Control Center
approval-rules.subtitle: Review explicit allow and block rules, inspect what the medium profile has learned, and reset local approval state when behavior drifts.

empty.learning: No learning signals yet. Medium mode starts learning after real approvals.

learning.description: Medium mode records one-off approvals, auto-promotes stable patterns, and slows down trust when approval history gets old.

danger.description: Use these resets when rules feel wrong or medium mode learned the wrong pattern.
danger.clearAllowsHelp: Delete all allow-side rules. Future matching operations will ask again.
danger.clearAllHelp: Delete all allow and block rules. This resets the local approval policy state.
danger.resetLearningHelp: Remove observed and auto-promoted learning rows while keeping explicit block rules.

confirm.clearAllowsBody: Stored allow rules and learned allow-side signals will be removed. Matching operations will ask again.
confirm.clearAllBody: This removes all allow and block rules plus learning state for approval decisions.
confirm.resetLearningBody: Observed approvals and auto-promoted allow rules will be deleted. Explicit block rules stay in place.
